title: Reset the failed status of a systemd unit
summary: Clear the 'failed' flag from a service that has already been fixed or stopped. This removes it from the list of failed units.

steps.explain: Reset the failed state of a specific unit. Note that this may unload the unit, so you might lose access to its logs via systemctl status.

placeholders.name: SERVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the failed systemd unit.

steps.expect: No error output. The unit should no longer appear in 'systemctl --failed'.

rollback.explain: If you need to see the logs again, you may need to restart the service or check the journal directly.

placeholders.name: SERVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the systemd unit.

warnings: Resetting a failed unit may unload it, making 'systemctl status' no longer report its previous failure or logs. Use 'journalctl' if you need to investigate the cause.
